metadata.title: Launch Day Playbook — Survive a Brainrot
metadata.context: Single-document launch checklist. 30 minutes from open to LIVE. 7 steps. Built during overnight sprint 2026-03-29.

launch_steps.title: Create 5 Game Passes
launch_steps.instruction: Find GamePassId = 0 → replace 0 with the real ID number

launch_steps.title: Create 16 Developer Products
launch_steps.instruction: Find each placeholder key → replace with numeric Product ID as string

options.A_rojo: rojo build default.project.json -o game.rbxl → open in Studio
options.B_manual: Follow StudioModulePlacementMap.md — UnifiedServer→ServerScriptService (.server.lua), UnifiedClient→StarterPlayerScripts (.client.lua), all others→ServerStorage/Modules/, create ReplicatedStorage/Remotes/ (empty)

launch_steps.title: Boot Test
procedure: Look for: [UnifiedServer] Boot complete — XX modules loaded
If errors: check file placement matches StudioModulePlacementMap.md

launch_steps.title: Publish
procedure: Name: Skibidi Zombie: Survive the Brainrots 🧟💀
Playable Devices: Phone ✅ Tablet ✅ PC ✅ Xbox ✅
Creator Dashboard → set game to Public

launch_steps.title: Verify Live
procedure: Join → complete FTUE → kill enemies → verify coins earned
Open shop → verify purchase prompts show correct prices

known_issues.impact: Smart offers won't trigger (basic shop still works)
known_issues.fix_when: After products created, update offer table

known_issues.impact: ReceiptRouter handles it if loaded first in UnifiedServer boot

known_issues.fix_when: Set to launch date after publish

post_launch_timeline.action: Monitor Creator Dashboard for CCU and revenue
Fix any crash bugs from real player data
Set BattlePass SEASON_START, activate daily challenges
Discord server live, first community event

emergency_troubleshooting.game_crashes: Check Output for exact error line + file. Most likely missing module or wrong folder.
emergency_troubleshooting.no_monetization: Verify Product IDs are numeric (not placeholder strings). Check ReceiptRouter loads before GamePassConfig.
emergency_troubleshooting.data_not_saving: Check DataStoreV2 STORE_NAME matches. Don't change store name after first save.
emergency_troubleshooting.mobile_broken: Check MobileInputController is in StarterPlayerScripts, not ServerStorage.

key_concepts.name: 30-Minute Launch Protocol
key_concepts.definition: Complete game launch from Studio to LIVE in exactly 30 minutes, 7 steps

key_concepts.name: Game Pass Monetization
key_concepts.definition: 5 Game Passes (99-1499 R$) providing permanent player upgrades

key_concepts.name: Developer Product Economy
key_concepts.definition: 16 consumable products across currency (6), consumables (6), and gacha (4)

key_concepts.name: Fail-Closed Monetization
key_concepts.definition: Server-authoritative purchase validation — if validation fails, purchase blocked, not gifted

key_concepts.name: Dual Deploy Path
key_concepts.definition: Rojo automated build OR manual paste via StudioModulePlacementMap — both produce same result

key_concepts.name: Boot Test Gate
key_concepts.definition: Zero red error lines in Output = PASS. Single validation gate before publish.

key_concepts.name: Post-Launch Cadence
key_concepts.definition: Hour 1 monitor → Day 1 hotfix → Day 2-3 BattlePass → Day 4-5 Discord → Day 7 World Boss

monetization_summary.revenue_model: F2P with premium currency (Coins + Gems), consumable boosts, gacha crates, permanent passes
